name: Amber Warden
tagline: Every gram accounted for, every audit already won.
positioning: Amber Warden turns seed-to-sale compliance into a calm, continuous ledger — so owner-operators stop firefighting and start building an empire.

hero.h1: Compliance that runs itself while you run the shop
hero.sub: Amber Warden reconciles your METRC packages, flags variance before the state does, and keeps every manifest, COA, and transfer audit-ready — for the dispensary owner who does it all.

features.title: METRC that reconciles itself
features.description: Nightly sync catches package mismatches, orphaned tags, and untagged inventory, then hands you a one-tap fix list instead of a 40-tab spreadsheet.

features.title: Variance caught before the state calls
features.description: Amber Warden watches weight loss, waste logs, and adjustments in real time and alerts you the moment a number drifts outside your license tolerance.

features.title: Every COA and manifest, one shelf
features.description: Certificates of analysis, transfer manifests, and vendor licenses live in one searchable vault — pull any document for an inspector in under ten seconds.

features.title: Audit mode for inspection day
features.description: Freeze a compliant snapshot, generate the exact report your state requires, and walk the inspector through it from your phone.

features.title: Multi-license, one command room
features.description: Cultivation, manufacturing, and retail licenses roll up into a single dashboard so you see your whole operation without switching logins.

features.title: Rule changes, translated
features.description: When your state amends packaging or testing rules, we push a plain-English changelog and update your checklists automatically.

testimonials.quote: We passed a surprise inspection in eleven minutes. Amber Warden had the manifests, COAs, and waste logs sorted before the inspector finished her coffee. It paid for itself that morning.
testimonials.name: Marisol Trejo

testimonials.quote: I used to spend every Sunday reconciling METRC by hand. Now the variance report is waiting for me and it's usually already clean. I got my weekends back.
testimonials.name: Devon Alcott

testimonials.quote: Running three licenses across two counties was a compliance nightmare. Amber Warden gave us one source of truth and our attorney fees dropped by half.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramaswamy
